A01.finding: scraper.py accepted financial compatibility data without requiring the Phase 4 artifact/evidence contract
correction: only local taxas_bacen.json may be consumed
schema_version 1.4.0 is mandatory
cdi_basis bcb_sgs_12_daily_compounded_252 is mandatory
SGS 432 and SGS 12 source identities are mandatory
artifact numeric values must reconcile with source provenance
verify_financial_artifact_evidence must pass before payroll consumption
dados_fiscais production evidence gate verifies all four external sources

A02.finding: financial observations had no source-specific freshness policy
correction: Selic Meta is persistent-until-changed and has no maximum age
Selic future observation dates are rejected
CDI daily observation must be at most seven calendar days old
CDI future observation dates are rejected
freshness is evaluated before a new taxas_bacen.json compatibility artifact is built

A03.finding: main.yml and taxas.yml shared a concurrency group but had asymmetric pending-run queue behavior
correction: both workflows use group sanida-dados-fiscais-writes-main
both use cancel-in-progress false
both use queue max

A04.finding: documentation and the foundation gate did not prove the complete final production boundary
correction: legacy-artifact boundary documentation reflects the migrated financial input
production persistence policy records the four-source composed evidence gate
machine-readable audit distinguishes foundation readiness from formal closure
scripts/validate_phase4_preclosure_gate.py verifies the corrected production boundary
scripts/validate_phase4_closure_gate.py authorizes closure only after A05 is executable and documented

A05.finding: the policy for consuming a preserved financial last-good after a current PARSER_INCOMPATIBLE state was unresolved
correction: current incompatible raw snapshot and parser failure state are persisted
previous last-good snapshot/candidate pointers remain intact for audit
existing taxas_bacen.json bytes remain unchanged
preserved last-good can be verified through an audit-only verifier
current PARSER_INCOMPATIBLE blocks normal financial evidence verification for new consumption
no new taxas_bacen.json may be generated from the preserved candidate
no new dados_fiscais.json may embed the quarantined financial last-good
generated_at may not be refreshed and values may not be relabeled as current
normal consumption resumes only after a current collection again produces PARSED with valid evidence
